3870.title: Project path terminal controls
3870.rootCauseOneLine: Project request validation accepts embedded ESC and the CLI table emits it unchanged.
3870.proposedFix: Define and enforce a control-character path policy; escape legacy paths on terminal output.
3870.caveats: Schema and CLI command reproduced with stubbed API transport; live HTTP persistence was not exercised. No PR: public request-schema changes are excluded by the rule.
